title: 新粗野主义
description: 黑框描到底，阴影是一块偏移的黑。一支 19.5 秒短片，全片只有一条物理——阴影长度就是高度：海报炸成十三颗键帽；一支笔先画框，注册表单从框里一个个长出来；卡片抬起来摊成阶梯；二十颗按钮的按压像水波一样扩散，再从 1952 年的清水混凝土、2014 年的粗野主义网页一路变回今天的界面；最后落进网页和手机 App。

images.titleEn: Four steps to restyle one card

descriptionEn: Black borders on everything; the shadow is a solid offset block. A 19.5-second film built on one piece of physics — shadow length is height: a poster shatters into thirteen keycaps; a pen draws each frame and a sign-up form grows out of the borders; a card lifts and fans into a staircase; twenty buttons ripple when pressed, turn into 1952 raw concrete and a 2014 brutalist web page, and come back as today's UI — then a landing page and a phone app assemble layer by layer.
